purpose: Before selecting a support/mode hypothesis group, query the actual ancestor record and failure history for the widest candidate support (interface15, 3 atom slots with an orientation triplet) to check whether its local geometry and role evidence are supported at the declared clock (predictive_bridge_to_learning_end vs actual_ancestor_at_learning_end), and whether prior failures in this region family indicate the function direction, dose, or target-formation issue. This is a discriminating check: interface15 is the only candidate with an orientation triplet and the largest support, so it can distinguish a geometry/orientation hypothesis from the smaller 2-point supports (interface16/17/19) and the 3-point interface22. No affinity derivative or SMC is assumed; chemistry modules are disabled, so only element/geometry proxies are used.
